stayType: Holiday park with caravans, cabins and pitches

suitableFor: Families, campers and tourers, dog owners, surfers.

overview: Woolacombe Sands is an independent holiday park overlooking Woolacombe's three miles of sand in North Devon. It offers caravans, sea-view cabins and camping and touring pitches, with indoor and outdoor pools, a clubhouse bar and restaurant. The beach is a 15-20 minute walk away.
surfTripFit: Walkable to Woolacombe beach and with wetsuit washing areas, it is one of the more surf-practical parks locally.
gaps: Parking, unit counts and board storage not stated; only homepage checked.
